title.zh: 币安推出Binance Intelligence AI产品栈，包含Binance AI、AI Pro与Agent OS
title.en: 【币安推出 AI 产品栈 Binance Intelligence，包含 AI Pro 与 Agent OS 等】

current_state.zh: 币安 Intelligence 产品栈中的 Binance AI Pro 已面向全球用户开放，覆盖网页端和 App，并提供免费与付费订阅层级；此前的 Beta 版继续运行并支持迁移。
current_state.en: Binance AI Pro, part of Binance Intelligence, is now globally available on web and app with free and paid subscription tiers; the prior beta remains available with migration support.

updates.what_changed_zh: 币安宣布推出 Binance Intelligence，这是一个由三部分组成的 AI 产品栈，包括面向消费者的免费产品 Binance AI、可将自然语言转化为可执行策略的 Binance AI Pro，以及面向开发者的 Binance Agent OS，自 10 月 5 日起陆续上线。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance announced Binance Intelligence, a three-part AI product stack comprising a free consumer Binance AI, Binance AI Pro that converts natural language into executable strategies, and Binance Agent OS for developers, rolling out starting October 5.

updates.title_zh: 币安在15万用户测试后推出AI交易工具
updates.title_en: Binance launches AI trading tool after 150,000-user beta
updates.what_changed_zh:
币安向所有英语用户开放了Binance AI——一个免费的生成式界面（generative UI）交易工具，此前该产品处于测试阶段，约有15万名测试者参与。

币安是按交易量计算最大的交易所，将AI驱动的界面开放给其全部英语零售用户，意味着AI工具从测试性实验进入主流交易流程。

Binance AI是一套免费功能组合，将图表、新闻、社交媒体、链上数据和研究工具的市场信号整合到单一界面中，并通过生成式界面适配不同用户的知识水平。本次开放范围限于英语用户。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance launched Binance AI, a free generative-UI trading interface, to all English-language users following a beta that involved roughly 150,000 testers.
updates.current_state_zh:
币安向所有英语用户开放了Binance AI——一个免费的生成式界面（generative UI）交易工具，此前该产品处于测试阶段，约有15万名测试者参与。

币安是按交易量计算最大的交易所，将AI驱动的界面开放给其全部英语零售用户，意味着AI工具从测试性实验进入主流交易流程。

Binance AI是一套免费功能组合，将图表、新闻、社交媒体、链上数据和研究工具的市场信号整合到单一界面中，并通过生成式界面适配不同用户的知识水平。本次开放范围限于英语用户。
updates.current_state_en: Binance launched Binance AI, a free generative-UI trading interface, to all English-language users following a beta that involved roughly 150,000 testers.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance launched Binance AI, a free generative-UI trading interface, to all English-language users following a beta that involved roughly 150,000 testers.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance launched Binance AI, a free generative-UI trading interface, to all English-language users following a beta that involved roughly 150,000 testers.
updates.background_zh: 币安此前已提供较为完整的自动化工具组合，包括现货网格、合约网格和套利机器人，并发布了用于连接其交易API的AI agent技能文档。生成式界面（generative UI）指让大语言模型不仅输出文本，还直接生成界面元素，从而按用户需求定制交互界面。
updates.background_en: Binance already offers a large built-in automation suite, including spot grid, futures grid and arbitrage bots, and has published documentation for AI agent skills that connect to its trading APIs. Generative UI refers to letting a large language model generate interface elements rather than only text, producing interfaces tailored to a user's request.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此次发布影响的是币安面向零售用户的入口，而非市场结构本身：如果该界面将图表、新闻、社交媒体与链上信号集中到一处，可能影响英语零售用户在币安上的下单路径与情绪判断方式。事件不涉及上币、费率或监管变更。
updates.market_impact_en: The rollout affects Binance's retail-facing channel rather than market structure: if the interface concentrates chart, news, social and onchain signals into one place, it could influence how English-language retail users route orders and interpret sentiment on the venue. No listing, fee or regulatory change is involved.

updates.what_changed_zh: 币安于10月19日在网页端和App面向全球所有用户推出币安 AI Pro，提供免费标准版和月费19.99 USDC的高级版；此前Beta版继续运行，用户可迁移聊天记录和策略。
updates.what_changed_en: Binance launched Binance AI Pro globally on web and app on October 19, offering a free standard tier and a 19.99 USDC monthly premium tier; the prior beta remains available with migration for chats and strategies.
updates.current_state_zh: 币安 Intelligence 产品栈中的 Binance AI Pro 已面向全球用户开放，覆盖网页端和 App，并提供免费与付费订阅层级；此前的 Beta 版继续运行并支持迁移。
updates.current_state_en: Binance AI Pro, part of Binance Intelligence, is now globally available on web and app with free and paid subscription tiers; the prior beta remains available with migration support.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance launched Binance AI Pro globally across web and app, a finance-focused AI agent that converts conversational trading ideas into testable automated strategy workflows, with a free standard tier and a 19.99 USDC monthly premium tier offering higher usage quotas and access to additional AI models.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance launched Binance AI Pro globally across web and app, a finance-focused AI agent that converts conversational trading ideas into testable automated strategy workflows, with a free standard tier and a 19.99 USDC monthly premium tier offering higher usage quotas and access to additional AI models.
updates.background_zh: 币安此前已推出用于智能体交易的 AI Pro Beta 版，其早前的币安 AI 产品可提供市场简报、智能提醒、盈亏摘要和个性化信息。此次正式上线将这些能力延伸至可在实盘执行的视觉化策略工作流。
updates.background_en: Binance previously ran a Beta version of AI Pro for agentic trading, and its earlier Binance AI offering provided market briefs, smart alerts, PnL summaries and personalized information. The full launch extends those capabilities into visual strategy workflows that can be executed in live trading.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该产品瞄准币安的零售订单流，把以往需要手工或第三方工具完成的策略执行自动化；以 USDC 计价的高级版订阅也为平台带来一个小额的经常性稳定币支付渠道。其对交易量或自动化占比的实际影响尚未得到验证。
updates.market_impact_en: The product targets retail order flow on Binance by automating strategy execution that previously required manual or third-party tooling, and the USDC-denominated Premium subscription creates a small recurring stablecoin payment channel on the platform. Any effect on trading volumes or automation share has yet to be demonstrated.
